plain_english: Action-intellect limitation obtained — then that bound soul is called. Thus by will He, blessed Bhairava, is measured.
sanskrit_cite: karmabuddhyakṣatāṃ prāptā tadāsau paśur ucyate | itīcchayā sa bhagavān bhairavaḥ parimīyate

plain_english: Limited in function, being — that power follows him. His Vidyeśa, Sadākhya, Śivahood — from contracted state: body, breath, intellect, void, knowership attained.
sanskrit_cite: mitavṛttis satī sā ca śaktis tam anuvartate | tasya vidyeśasādākhyaśivatās saṃkucatsthiteḥ

plain_english: His particular creation — that-and-that various imagination — Śaiva creation arisen — impression of the purified dependent-on-that.
Knower indeed — this of-such-kind — at festival-of-limitation undistracted abides — in own self, without thought, consciousness-self.
sanskrit_cite: pramātaivāyam etāvatprakāro 'vagrahotsave avyagro vartate | svātmany avikalpe cidātmake

plain_english: Child, see — you indeed this as-nondual — of consciousness known, of-that-made world — other trivial unreal — because.
sanskrit_cite: vatsa paśya tvam evaitat advayatvena saṃvidaḥ | viditaṃ tanmayaṃ viśvam anyat tuccham asad yataḥ

plain_english: What means this principle — from which other not indeed possible — without-other-means — this self-means — called.
sanskrit_cite: kim upāyam idaṃ tattvaṃ yato 'nyan naiva sambhavi | ananyopāyam etat tadātmopāyaṃ pracakṣate
